categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan mutex and synchronization in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp.
categories.rationale: Converting DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan's mutex from recursive to non-recursive removes re-entrancy deadlock hazards and advances the codebase-wide effort (#19303) to eliminate recursive mutexes. The PR description notes no database format, RPC behavior, or keypool semantics change, making this an internally focused locking refactoring without an active bug report.
